limitations: Mentions, not distinct runs: one run's result can be quoted several times in one report.
PARTIAL means check.sh was run with a gate skipped (for example --skip sbt) and cannot count as the full definition of done.
Phase 15's later runs (Q12 and option A) are in the coordinator notes, see check-runs-local.
check_results_in_test_reports.rule: Lines in docs/agent-runs/phase-NN/test-report.md (the coordinator's observed results) containing 'RESULT: PASS gates=N', 'RESULT: FAIL failed: <gate>' or 'RESULT: PARTIAL passed=N' (check.sh's own result lines; a run may be quoted on more than one line, so these are result-line mentions, not distinct runs).

course_checks.evidence_that_exists: check.sh (scripts/check.sh, sha256 da62fc8884a7) ran on clean SNAPSHOTS in Phase 14: a git clone of the repository into a scratch directory with the uncommitted files copied in and committed there, identity proved with cmp (procedure at docs/agent-runs/phase-14/test-report.md, 'Clean-snapshot procedure'; headings: [15, 37, 61, 159, 167, 254, 295, 337, 379, 633, 723, 781]). A snapshot is a clone plus the working-tree changes, not a fresh clone of the pushed commit.
course_checks.what_is_missing: a fresh clone of the pushed branch on a machine or directory with no prior target/ state, running sbt check and scripts/check.sh to RESULT: PASS gates=7. Planned for Phase 17; not claimed here.

course_checks.evidence_that_exists: the local P6 chain was replayed repeatedly on the same input (see check-runs-local.json: logical outputs identical across the passing runs); the same Hadoop counters appear on EMR (docs/agent-runs/phase-15/evidence/session-2/emr/hadoop-prep-counters.txt, committed) and locally; the EMR run's Spark step failed, so the full chain has no EMR replay.
